{"explanation": "This document is a credit note (CN-2026-0974) for ZAR 5,843.5 from Highveld Office Supplies, not a standard invoice, so it cannot be posted as a Bill and was held. Vendor credits are handled manually, so please process it through the manual credit-note workflow and confirm it against PO-CRSUFFIXZA before any offset is applied.",
"email_subject": "Request for confirmation: Credit note CN-2026-0974",
"email_body": "Dear Highveld Office Supplies team,

Thank you for your correspondence. We received credit note CN-2026-0974, dated 24 April 2025, for a total of ZAR 5,843.50 referencing PO-CRSUFFIXZA.

To help us process this correctly, could you please confirm the following:
1. That this document is intended as a credit note against PO-CRSUFFIXZA, and the amount of ZAR 5,843.50 is correct.
2. The original invoice number(s) this credit note applies to.

If a corrected document or a statement of account would be more appropriate, please send it and we will review it.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
